description.content: Stoned Meadow of Doom is the premier heavy rock promotion channel on the web. For over 10 years, SMOD has been the biggest and best platform for all things Stoned and Doomed! A feature on this channel exposes you to the largest collection of music fans you're likely to find online. Founded and ran by Clint Beed, a small town dude with the burning desire to showcase the music that actually deserves to be heard. Disgusted with the state of the mindless "music" my peers listen to, I started Stoned Meadow of Doom in 2013 to make a change.

channelMetadataRenderer.title: Stoned Meadow Of Doom
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
Stoned Meadow of Doom is the premier heavy rock promotion channel on the web. For over 10 years, SMOD has been the biggest and best platform for all things Stoned and Doomed! A feature on this channel exposes you to the largest collection of music fans you're likely to find online. Founded and ran by Clint Beed, a small town dude with the burning desire to showcase the music that actually deserves to be heard. Disgusted with the state of the mindless "music" my peers listen to, I started Stoned Meadow of Doom in 2013 to make a change.
If you are in a band you can send any upload requests to my email:  stonedmeadowofdoom@gmail.com

Support SMOD if you appreciate this service.  SMOD is a full time job for me.  https://www.patreon.com/MeadowOfDoom

You can also donate via Paypal:   paypal.me/StonedMeadowOfDoom

I have started a music group on Facebook called SMOD Nation.  Please join for music, and a politically incorrect great time.  https://www.facebook.com/groups/188446978
